entities.summary: Tomáš Týn OP was a Czech Dominican priest of the Czech Province and professor of moral theology at the University of Bologna. His beatification process was opened on 25 February, 2006 by the Archbishop of Bologna, Carlo Caffarra, in the Basilica S. Domenico dei Frati Predicatori.
